Predicted Means for Linear and Semiparametric Models

Source: R/predictmeans-package.R
predictmeans-package.Rd

This package provides functions to diagnose and make inferences from various linear models, such as those obtained from 'aov', 'lm', 'glm', 'gls', 'lme', 'lmer', 'glmmTMB' and 'semireg'. Inferences include predicted means and standard errors, contrasts, multiple comparisons, permutation tests, adjusted R-square and graphs. Vignettes (browseVignettes("predictmeans")) show worked examples. For AI assistants and scripted use, system.file("llms-context.md", package = "predictmeans") gives a compact description of the result tables, defaults and common recipes.
